refused_program.body:
set -e

tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT

upstream_ref="{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}"
file=deps.lock

git fetch {upstream_remote} || true

if [ ! -e .git/MERGE_HEAD ]; then
  git merge --no-commit --no-ff "$upstream_ref" || true
fi

base=$(git merge-base HEAD "$upstream_ref")
git show "$base:$file" > "$tmp/base"
git show "HEAD:$file" > "$tmp/local"
git show "$upstream_ref:$file" > "$tmp/upstream"

mkdir "$tmp/diff"
cp "$tmp/base" "$tmp/diff/base"
cp "$tmp/local" "$tmp/diff/local"
( cd "$tmp/diff" && git diff --no-index -U0 base local > patch || true )

awk '
  /^@@ / {
    if (hunk != "" && !(has_plus && has_minus)) printf "%s", hunk
    hunk=$0 "\n"; has_plus=0; has_minus=0; next
  }
  {
    if (hunk == "") { print; next }
    hunk = hunk $0 "\n"
    if ($0 ~ /^\+/ && $0 !~ /^\+\+\+/) has_plus=1
    if ($0 ~ /^-/ && $0 !~ /^---/) has_minus=1
  }
  END { if (hunk != "" && !(has_plus && has_minus)) printf "%s", hunk }
' "$tmp/diff/patch" > "$tmp/diff/patch.apply"

if grep -q '^@@' "$tmp/diff/patch.apply"; then
  ( cd "$tmp/diff" && git apply --unidiff-zero patch.apply )
fi

git merge-file -p --union "$tmp/upstream" "$tmp/base" "$tmp/diff/base" > "$tmp/merged" || true

start=$(awk '/^[[:space:]]*packages[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*\[[[:space:]]*$/ { print NR; exit }' "$tmp/merged")
if [ -n "$start" ]; then
  end=$(awk -v s="$start" 'NR > s && /^[[:space:]]*\][[:space:]]*$/ { print NR; exit }' "$tmp/merged")
  if [ -n "$end" ]; then
    head -n "$start" "$tmp/merged" > "$tmp/before"
    sed -n "$((start + 1)),$((end - 1))p" "$tmp/merged" | sort > "$tmp/block"
    tail -n +"$end" "$tmp/merged" > "$tmp/after"
    cat "$tmp/before" "$tmp/block" "$tmp/after" > "$tmp/merged.sorted"
    mv "$tmp/merged.sorted" "$tmp/merged"
  fi
fi

cp "$tmp/merged" "$file"
git add "$file"
git commit --no-edit
